summary: STMicroelectronics N.V. filed a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026, announcing the publication of its IFRS 2026 semi-annual accounts for the six-month period ended June 27, 2026. The report was posted on the company's website and filed with the Netherlands Authority for the Financial Markets, as required for a foreign private issuer. This is a routine financial reporting disclosure, not a special situation. No corporate event, transaction, or strategic action is mentioned. The filing contains only the semi-annual financial statement publication notice and standard contact information.
